name: Pulsecraft
description: A free, no-install rhythm training tool. Pick a pattern, set a tempo, drum on your phone or desk. Works offline after first load.

tools.label: Pattern library
tools.desc: 200+ patterns tagged by style and difficulty

tools.label: Visual metronome
tools.desc: High-contrast visual click, no audio needed

faq.q: Can I export patterns to Logic or Ableton?
faq.a: Yes. Each pattern exports as MIDI or WAV.
Self-taught drummers, music-school students, and teachers running group sessions on a shared screen.

howto.name: Practice a new rhythm in five minutes with Pulsecraft

steps.name: Open the site
steps.text: Go to pulsecraft.app on any device.

steps.name: Pick a pattern
steps.text: Open the library, filter by style, pick one at your level.

steps.name: Set a tempo
steps.text: Start at 70% of the pattern's target BPM.

steps.name: Play it twenty times
steps.text: Loop at that tempo until you can play it without looking at the screen.

steps.name: Raise the tempo 5%
steps.text: Nudge the metronome up until you're at target BPM.
